facts.fact: Sundancer 房车夜里在公路上熄火、漂向公路左侧——与 Nate 同车的卡座同伴 Benjamin Heavy Runner 翻出收据后怒吼：司机 Christian 只买了刚好够开到这里的油，气得把收据揉成一团扔掉；而他们三小时前才刚加满过。
facts.anchor: “He only bought enough to get us here!” Benjamin said, balling the receipt up and throwing it down.

facts.fact: Christian 把圣经塞进衬衫、拎上自己的肉干和行李袋，向 Nate 点头道别后下车，借车灯横穿公路、按印第安人的老规矩沿右侧路肩步行走进黑夜——Nate 明白他不是去加油，而是回对面的乌鸦保留地（他之前说的「Cur」就是 Crow）。
facts.anchor: Christian’s tall lanky form was galumphing ahead through the headlights, then he was checking the road again to jog across, into the darkness, walk the right-side shoulder in time-honored Indian fashion.

facts.fact: 此前 Benjamin 用皮革工具卷把藏在房车卧室墙里的越野摩托修好、点火成功；随后他把那块花岗岩小钟抛过白色路肩线，出于珍惜本能迈步去接，被一辆只亮着昏暗大灯的大卡车拦腰撞上、化作血雾溅了 Nate 和摩托一身——Nate 对着他刚才站的位置说「Say you're a Heavy Runner? Not anymore.」
facts.anchor: The big truck with the dim headlights clipped him hard with its tall grill, its unstoppable bumper, turned him to mist.

facts.fact: 杂物抽屉里的手机响起——那是 Nurse Seine 买的手机（Mooch 在那场杀害之后拿去藏在抽屉里）；Nate 接起，护士 KellyKel 误把他当成 Seine，告知：是关于那个 Spear Woman 男孩的事，Dr. Rodge 当天早上已宣布他死亡——Nate 明白那是他想救的 Sebby，泪流满面。
facts.anchor: Your text said to call you? It’s about the Spear Woman boy. Dr. Rodge pronounced him this morning, I’m sorry.

facts.fact: Nate 想通真相：Father X 自 Carlisle 起就寄生在他体内（Nurse Seine 只是声东击西的幌子，她用钟劈开他的头反而给了 Father X 入口），Father X 嗜好印第安儿童，想借这个不知情的宿主被偷渡回保留地——以 Blackfeet Early Childhood Systems 新老师/校车司机/门卫的身份通过所有背景审查，因为那些审查都查不到一百五十年前。
facts.anchor: The reservation. A new teacher or bus driver or janitor at Blackfeet Early Childhood Services, one who would say all the right things in the interview, have all the right credentials, would pass every background check, because none of them went back a hundred and fifty years.

facts.fact: Nate 在墓地里忍不住排尿，尿出的东西先黄后变黑、约半加仑——他意识到自己是在把 Father X 尿出来（Father X 躲在他疼痛的中心、躲过了他手臂上被割开的口子）；随后他用 Mooch 的冰锥在乱葬岗的土里捅出深洞，那团黑物认出洞是排水口、顺洞流尽，他把冰锥插进洞里压住。
facts.anchor: He was peeing Father X out, had been so desperate to go that he hadn’t thought about it first, hadn’t given Father X any heads-up, Father X who must have known to hide from that obvious door Nate had cut in his arm.

facts.fact: 地点揭示：抛锚处正是 Greasy Grass——夜里的 Little Bighorn（Last Stand Hill），是爸爸很久以前带他来、让他见识「身为印第安人意味着什么」的地方；Nate 决定把 Father X 连同自己一起留在这里。
facts.anchor: This was Greasy Grass. Little Bighorn at night. The place his dad had taken him so long ago, to show him what it meant to be Indian.

facts.fact: 结局：Nate 用 Mooch 的冰锥割开左前臂、用那双曾绕在 Christian 圣经上的靴带扎紧伤口，摩托半路熄火后步行走上 Last Stand Hill；他对着墓园里那只充气恐龙说了声「Thank you」，抱着流血的手臂、握拳按在心口，闭上眼睛，放他最好的朋友（Sebby）走。
facts.anchor: “Thank you,” Nate whispered, holding his bleeding arm across his heart, his hand a tight fist, and then he closed his eyes, let his best friend go.
